facts.statement: The official news teaser promotes a Mechanical Mystery Chest in Free Realms, featuring the characters Chris and Lola.
facts.quote: Viens découvrir le Coffre mystère mécanique dans Free Realms avec Chris et Lola!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quais são as Novidades?
article_summaries.summary: A short Portuguese-language official news teaser (freerealms.com, captured 2012-11-03) promoting a 'Coffre mystère mécanique' (Mechanical Mystery Chest) with the characters Chris and Lola, and stating that mechanical equipment can now be used in the game. The page is a fragment with no date, details of the chest's contents, or odds, so it gives little mechanical detail for a rebuild.
